findings.title: Migration crashes with IndexError when `embed_category` site setting is not present
findings.body: The migration indexes directly into the `PG::Result` returned by `execute` with `[0]['id']`: `execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories AS c INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i`. On any database where `embed_category` was never modified (and thus has no row in `site_settings`) or does not match an existing category name, the query returns 0 rows and `result[0]` raises `IndexError: Index 0 is out of range` (or `NoMethodError` on `nil`), aborting the migration. The same issue applies to line 15 if `uncategorized_category_id` has no row in `site_settings`.

findings.title: Migrated `embeddable_hosts` values are not normalized and will fail host matching
findings.body: Previously, `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` accepted entries containing schemes (`http://`, `https://`) or paths (e.g. `https://example.com/1234`), which `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` parsed via `URI(h).host`. `EmbeddableHost` strips schemes and paths in a `before_validation` callback and `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` directly against `uri.host`. Because the migration inserts raw `h` strings via SQL `INSERT`, the `before_validation` normalization is bypassed and any existing host entries with a scheme or path will no longer match incoming requests.

findings.title: `before_validation` raises `NoMethodError` when `host` is `nil`
findings.body: In the `before_validation` callback, `self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` is called unconditionally. If `host` is `nil` (for example, `EmbeddableHost.new.valid?` or a request with a missing `host` parameter), this raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'sub!' for nil:NilClass` instead of failing validation with a model error.

findings.title: `record_for_host` fails to match uppercase hostnames or hosts with ports
findings.body: In `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, `uri = URI(host)` and `host = uri.host` preserve uppercase characters from the input URL (e.g. `URI('http://Example.com/foo').host` returns `'Example.com'`), while `where('lower(host) = ?', host)` only lowercases the database column and not the query parameter (`host.downcase`). Additionally, the format validation on line 2 explicitly allows ports (`(:[0-9]{1,5})?`), which are preserved in `self.host`, but `uri.host` excludes the port, so any `EmbeddableHost` configured with a port will never match.

findings.title: Contents of `category_fabricator.rb` and `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` are swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was overwritten with `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)`, while the category fabricators (`:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category`, `:private_category`) were placed in `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb`.

findings.title: Saving a host leaves stale buffered state and sets `category` to `undefined` when defaulted
findings.body: In `save()`, if a new host is saved without explicitly choosing a category, `this.get('categoryId')` is `null`. The server defaults `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and returns it in the response payload, but line 38 overwrites `host.category` with `Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))` (`undefined`) instead of using `host.get('category_id')`. Additionally, `commitBuffer()` / `rollbackBuffer()` is not called after `host.save(props)`, so if the server normalizes `host` (e.g. stripping `https://` or a path), re-entering edit mode displays the un-normalized buffered string rather than the saved `host.host`.

findings.title: `expandable_first_post?` spec for blank `embeddable_host` is a false positive
findings.body: `Topic#expandable_first_post?` no longer checks whether any `EmbeddableHost` exists (it only checks `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`). In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb`, the `before` block setting `SiteSetting.embed_truncate = true` and stubbing `has_topic_embed?` was moved inside `describe 'with an emeddable host'`, so `it 'is false if embeddable_host is blank'` only passes because `embed_truncate` and `has_topic_embed?` are both `false` in that scope.
